characters.name: Priya
characters.appearance: Young Indian woman with a slim build and medium complexion. She has dark, curly, shoulder-length hair and clear facial features.

scenes.supernova_script:
Sushma says: Who are you talking to on the phone?
Miss Nova says: I am Miss Nova. I help people actually speak English, by talking with them.
Sushma says: Really?
Miss Nova says: Yes! I figure out your exact level first, and then build a personalized plan just for you.
Sushma says: My knees hurt a lot. How do I say this in English?
Miss Nova says: Just try speaking it, and I will help you.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Hooks with curiosity about the AI voice
- Names English immediately
- Lands personalization beat (a) early
- Sets up the interactive speaking loop
